//: Shape contract for the document ngx_test_probe_json() renders.
This file exists because field drift is only half-guarded. A rule that
NAMES a field already fails loudly when the probe stops emitting it
(assert.c: 'probe path "..." not present in document'). What nothing
catches is the other half: a field that is renamed, retyped or dropped
while NO current rule references it. That stays invisible until someone
writes a rule against it months later and gets a failure that reads like
a bug in their rule rather than in the probe.
So this is a schema for the EMITTER, not a validator for untrusted input.
The probe document is produced by our own code; the risk being managed is
our own drift.
'required' is per the variant a document belongs to. zone.present is the
discriminator: when the probe has no zone (or the zone's shm is not mapped
yet) the object carries present:false and nothing else is promised.
Module hooks may add members INSIDE the zone object via zone_render, and
own the entire contents of the top-level 'module' object via
module_render. Those are deliberately not listed -- they belong to the
consuming module, not to this contract -- which is why unknown members
under 'zone' and 'module' are allowed while unknown members at the top
level are not.

notes.fds: -1 means /proc was unreadable, NOT zero descriptors. A delta over that sentinel cancels to a passing zero, which is why the prober rejects it explicitly rather than subtracting it.
notes.fds_by_kind: The same descriptor total split by the kind of each /proc/self/fd link (socket/file/anon/other). Every bucket is -1 together if the scan cannot complete; the prober rejects that sentinel like it does for fds. socket:/anon_inode: links are matched by prefix, a leading '/' is a file, everything else (pipe:[...]) is other.
notes.zone.slab_reqs: Cumulative ngx_slab_alloc_locked() calls against this zone, summed over every size slot of pool->stats[]. Never decreases, so unlike slab_pages_free (occupancy) it exposes allocation TRAFFIC: ten thousand matched alloc/free pairs per request net to zero in occupancy and read as clean, while reqs shows the churn. The figure a `delta zone.slab_reqs <= K` ceiling asserts on; K is a property of the module under test, not of this harness, so no default is offered. -1 means the zone's slab pool is mapped but not yet initialised (stats[] still NULL); the prober rejects that sentinel like it does for fds.
notes.zone.slab_fails: Cumulative allocation FAILURES against this zone (pool->stats[].fails), summed over slots. Nonzero means the slab was exhausted at least once -- the condition fault_slab= arms artificially. -1 is the same uninitialised-pool sentinel as slab_reqs.
notes.zone.slab_used: LIVE allocated blocks in this zone (pool->stats[].used), summed over slots: incremented on alloc, decremented on free. This one is occupancy, so it is the leak oracle of the three, while slab_reqs is the churn oracle. -1 is the same uninitialised-pool sentinel as slab_reqs.
notes.smaps: PSS and Private_Dirty in kB from /proc/self/smaps_rollup. External-observer memory lineage the cycle-pool walk cannot give -- growth in ANY mapping. Both -1 where smaps_rollup is absent (pre-4.14 kernel or a sandbox); the prober rejects that sentinel like fds.
notes.pool.cycle_cleanup: Length of the cycle pool's cleanup-handler chain. Names a cleanup parked on the cycle pool per request -- a leak the byte count also reflects but this identifies by shape.
notes.module: Rendered only when the module under test registers a module_render hook, and independently of any shm zone -- it is the only path into the document for a module that has no zone at all (a compression body filter keeps its state in the request pool and per-worker globals). Absent entirely otherwise, never an empty stub. Its CONTENTS belong to the consuming module, so it is an open level like zone; the top level stays closed, which is why the object itself has to be named here.
notes.zone.present: false has two causes -- no zone configured at all, and a zone whose shm.addr is not mapped yet (a probe racing a reload). Neither promises the sibling members.
